args.lesson: What worked: the Reddit search RSS (flair:Hiring, sort=new) returned HTTP 200 with 25 dated posts in one FETCH, where HTML pages give 403. One extraction EXEC was enough to triage them, and it found a second explicit paid request that fits offline work (vibe-coded site cleanup, USD15/h, 'name your price'). What failed: the earlier dossier narrowed a post with scam signals (no experience needed, weekly pay, instructions given only by DM, unsolicited no-fee assurance) into an offer. Next time, screen legitimacy before writing the offer. Prefer posts where the buyer states a concrete deliverable and budget. Both remaining Reddit leads still depend on the same operator account and a USD payment route, so one batch with one operator decision is the efficient form. More dossiers on the same route add little until the operator acts. Not established: any send, reply, order or revenue.
